verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a full public API (api-reference) covering projects, experiments, datasets, logging, prompts, and scorers, backed by SDKs (JS/Python examples), a CLI (`bt`), and an MCP server for agent/editor integration, indicating strong programmatic and agentic access. Some caveats exist: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec was found via probes, and one community comment notes sparse docs, slightly undercutting the 'documented' claim.
